exercises.hint: A file is ignored if it starts with any pattern. Array.some() plus startsWith() does the job in one line.
exercises.task: Simulate .gitignore matching: write shouldIgnore(file) which returns true if the file path starts with any pattern in the ignore list.

exercises.hint: Filter required down to the names missing from env, then print "missing: <name>" for each — or "all good" if none are missing.
exercises.task: Apps often validate their config on startup. Write checkEnv(env, required): for each required variable missing from env, print "missing: <name>"; if nothing is missing, print "all good".

exercises.hint: Return an object: port from env.PORT (default 3000), nodeEnv from env.NODE_ENV (default "development"). JSON.stringify the result.
exercises.task: Build an app config from environment variables with defaults: port comes from PORT (default 3000), nodeEnv comes from NODE_ENV (default "development"). Print the config as JSON.
